scores.evidence_span:
#### Complementary: LinkedIn

LinkedIn is appropriate for:

- Professional audience discovery.
scores.rationale: Names LinkedIn and identifies its professional-audience discovery function, a concrete platform characteristic relevant to including professional channels. The supplied generic cap limits the score to 6.

scores.evidence_span:
| LinkedIn | High for B2B professionals | Medium to high inside professional network | Text, carousels, short video, polls | High | Low | Low to medium | Leads, partnerships, workshops, sponsors |
| Newsletter/site | High for returning audience | Low without external distribution | Briefs, essays, resources | Low | High | Medium | Paid subscriptions, products, services |
| X or similar real-time network | High among some AI communities | Fast but volatile | Commentary, threads, live discussion | High | Low | High attention burden | Sponsorships, leads, subscriptions where available |
| TikTok/Reels/Shorts | Broad top-of-funnel | Potentially high | Short demonstrations and myth correction | Very high | Low | Medium | Awareness, sponsors, commerce depending on market |
scores.rationale: Explicitly distinguishes LinkedIn's B2B professional audience from the broad top-of-funnel audience of TikTok/Reels/Shorts. This establishes an option-level professional-versus-broad-reach difference rather than treating all channels alike. The supplied generic cap limits the score to 6.

scores.evidence_span: YouTube is the best default primary platform because the account’s core differentiation depends on demonstrations, evidence, technical explanation, and narrative depth.
scores.rationale: Knowledge-oriented content requirements explicitly determine YouTube's fit and selection as the primary platform. The preference therefore affects the recommendation, rather than merely appearing in a list of features. The supplied generic cap limits the score to 6.
